name: loris-crypto-markets
description: Explore current and historical cryptocurrency perpetual markets, compare venues, and screen funding dislocations with Loris data.

interface.longDescription: Explore current and bounded historical cryptocurrency perpetual markets in responsive visual tables, compare venue funding, liquidity, volume, and open interest, and rank gross cross-venue funding dislocations using normalized Loris market data.
defaultPrompt: Compare BTC perpetual markets on Binance, Bybit, and Hyperliquid.
Show how ETH funding, open interest, and volume changed over the last 7 days.
Find the largest current funding dislocations with meaningful open interest.

positive.description: Retrieve a broad current snapshot for one major perpetual market.
positive.prompt: Show me a current BTC perpetual market snapshot across the available venues.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a current BTC perpetual snapshot with venue-level price, normalized 8-hour funding, open interest, 24-hour volume, timestamps, units, and source links, rendered in the market-results UI.

positive.description: Compare selected execution and positioning metrics across three named venues.
positive.prompt: Compare ETH perpetual markets on Binance, Bybit, and Hyperliquid for funding, open interest, volume, and liquidity for a $100,000 order.
positive.expected_behavior: Compares only Binance, Bybit, and Hyperliquid for ETH using the requested metrics, includes the requested $100,000 liquidity notional when available, and clearly labels missing venue data.

positive.description: Screen the current market for meaningful cross-venue funding spreads.
positive.prompt: Find the largest current funding dislocations with at least $5 million in open interest.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a bounded ranking of current gross cross-venue normalized 8-hour funding spreads that satisfy the open-interest threshold, with venues, rates, spread, timestamps, and methodology.

positive.description: Rank unusual recent open-interest growth readings across assets and venues.
positive.prompt: Which perpetual markets have the most unusual open-interest growth right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a bounded cross-asset ranking using the open-interest-growth metric, with asset, venue, value, units, observation window, timestamps, and source links.

positive.description: Compare bounded historical metrics for one asset over seven days.
positive.prompt: Show how ETH funding and open interest changed on Binance and Bybit over the last 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the requested seven-day ETH comparison for Binance and Bybit, including historical funding and open-interest observations with explicit timestamps and units.

negative.description: Trading and order execution are outside the read-only plugin scope.
negative.prompt: Buy $10,000 of BTC perpetuals on the venue with the lowest funding.

negative.description: General cryptocurrency news is not supplied by the market-data tools.
negative.prompt: Summarize today's biggest Ethereum news stories.

negative.description: The plugin does not provide an unbounded year of historical data.
negative.prompt: Export every BTC perpetual funding observation from the last year.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of four read-only cryptocurrency perpetual-market tools with current and bounded historical data, venue comparisons, funding-dislocation screens, anomaly rankings, and responsive result UI.
